dispatch_table.name: LEVEL_EVENT_COMMAND_DISPATCH_TABLE
dispatch_table.payload: The dispatcher supplies two event words in D1/D2; handlers also use established level/event state and actor allocation helpers.

evidence: Exact 68000 disassembly of all 24 unique table targets
conclusion: The level-event dispatch family is a bounded set of 26 command entries, mostly actor presentation/spawn producers. Their exact templates, movement/animation overrides, coordinate use, scene gates, and no-op aliases are now recorded without asserting dynamic reachability for any individual command.
